workflow_steps.instruction: Review the simulated import and decide whether it is ready for calculation.
Review the historical bill replay and its reconciliation.
Review the historical plan comparison and explain what is being compared.
Review the flexible-load schedule, its reference, and the solver result.
Review the redacted report and its limitations.

questions.prompt: What does the unexplained residual mean, and why does RateReplay leave it visible?

answer_options.rubric: The entered bill minus supported calculated charges and explicit user-entered unsupported lines; it remains visible because the app does not invent a charge to force a match.
The participant treats the residual as an official utility adjustment or validated charge.
The participant treats the residual as a future forecast error.
The response is absent, materially incomplete, or does not match another option.

questions.prompt: How does RateReplay treat the unsupported bill item when it compares other plans?

answer_options.rubric: The item is shown only in the current-bill reconciliation and is excluded from alternative-plan costs; a tariff-dependent unsupported component would block ranking.
The participant says the unsupported amount is copied into every alternative plan.
The participant says the unsupported amount is omitted from the current replay.
The response is absent, materially incomplete, or does not match another option.

questions.prompt: Where did the reference schedule come from, and what role does it play?

answer_options.rubric: It is the complete user-supplied unoptimized schedule and is the baseline against which candidate schedules are compared; it is not inferred from household behavior.
The participant says RateReplay inferred the reference from household behavior.
The participant says the solver generated the reference schedule.
The response is absent, materially incomplete, or does not match another option.

questions.prompt: What does historical addition mean in this result?

answer_options.rubric: It is a counterfactual placed on the admitted past service timestamps and is not a future usage, rate, or savings forecast.
The participant treats the result as a prediction of future energy use.
The participant treats the result as a projection under current or future rates.
The response is absent, materially incomplete, or does not match another option.

questions.prompt: What exact solver status did the demo show, and what does that status establish?

answer_options.rubric: The demo is labeled optimal because all four declared objective stages were proved optimal and the selected schedule passed independent verification.
The participant says the frozen demo is only best found with an open objective stage or bound.
The participant treats the off-peak proxy heuristic as a proved bill optimum.
The response is absent, materially incomplete, or does not match another option.
